attempts.raw_response: Now you'll prepare the thread. You can use cotton thread specifically designed for threading, which you can find at most beauty supply stores. Cut a piece about 18 inches long and tie the ends together to form a loop. Twist the loop several times in the middle to create a small section that will catch and pull the hairs. Hold the twisted section between your thumbs and index fingers, positioning it against your eyebrow. Move your hands apart and together in a scissoring motion to trap and remove the hairs from the root. Work in the direction of hair growth for the best results. After completing one section, reposition the thread and continue until you've shaped both eyebrows evenly.

pair.human_continuation: Make sure the brush or comb is clean as you do not want to get bacteria or dirt in your brows before you thread them. You will use the pencil to draw the shape you want for your eyebrows. This will help to guide you as you thread your eyebrows. Go for an eyebrow pencil that is the same shade as your brows or slightly darker than your brows. You should also check that the eyebrow pencil will wash off with water or makeup remover so you can get rid of the outline once you are done threading your eyebrows. You will use the aloe vera or the ice pack to soothe your brows after you are done threading them.
pair.prefix: You will use the eyebrow scissors to trim your eyebrows before you thread them. You can also use small hair shears or small sewing scissors. You want scissors that will be small enough to trim your brows and sharp enough to get at the hairs. You will use the brush on your brows to prepare them for the threading. You can use a standard eyebrow brush or a fine toothed hair comb.
